g.text: An 8-parameter constructor becomes a sentence you can actually read.
new PaymentClient("stripe", null, 500, 3, null, true, false, null)
8 positional args -- which one is retries? which is useTLS?
each call returns `this` -- no object exists yet
Named, chainable calls read top to bottom in the order you actually care about --
never a fixed positional order every caller has to memorize.
